mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, compressing valuation multiples and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% over the 2000-2005 historical window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid unemployment rate increase (UNRATE > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods when UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from prior quarter values.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) forces aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp industrial production decline (INDPRO < -0.5% in 3 months) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO falls by >0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 < 1.0% QoQ) and rising policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicate active monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% and FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% MoM.
